newsitem.title: UK: Libya lifts Nov Es Sider, Sirtica crudes by 10 cts.
newsitem.headline: Libya lifts Nov Es Sider, Sirtica crudes by 10 cts.

text.p: Libya has raised the price of its key Es Sider crude for November by 10 cents a barrel to Dated Brent plus 10 cents, traders said on Wednesday.
Libya's National Oil Corporation (NOC) also raised the price of Sirtica by 10 cents to Dated Brent plus 15 cents.
Brega and Zueitina were raised by five cents a barrel to Dated Brent plus 45 cents. NOC also added five cents to Bu Attifel, pricing it at Dated Brent less 25 cents a barrel in November.
Sarir, Amna and Bouri were left unchanged from October at Dated Brent less 50 cents, Dated less 55 cents and Iranian Heavy less 35 cents respectively, the trading sources said.
